title: There’s a Fatty Liver Epidemic. AI Could Help Get Ahead of It
summary: The Fib-4 index, for example, rates a person’s risk of advanced liver fibrosis through computing a score of between 0 and 6, based on their age, their levels of two liver enzymes, and their blood-clotting ability.
